datasets.name: Optimal-view dataset (YA-OP)
datasets.verbatim: In this area, we interpreted over 300 old loess landslide samples through manual interpretation in Google 3D Scene... In the end, an optimal-view dataset containing 176 correctly labeled samples was obtained.

datasets.name: Multi-view images
datasets.verbatim: Multi-view images were obtained by MAC, specifically by modifying the parameters of the Google location file. Images from different views were generated in Google 3D Scenes automatically.

methods.name: Optimal-view and multi-view strategic hybrid deep learning (OMV-HDL)
methods.summary: The OMV-HDL method consists of a training step using an optimal-view dataset and a detection step using multi-view images. It employs a hybrid deep learning (HDL) model combining YOLOv5 (for local features) and DETR (for global features), with results fused by the Weighted Boxes Fusion (WBF) algorithm.
methods.verbatim: In this paper, considering the above challenges and the properties of CNNs and transformers and inspired by the interpretation process of human experts from different views, a novel optimal-view and multi-view strategic hybrid deep learning (OMV-HDL) method was proposed to detect old loess landslides effectively.

availability.author_statement: The data presented in this study are available on request from the corresponding author.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory dataset is not referenced or linked, and the custom OMV-HDL method code is not provided or linked.
